humanQA.a: Merged 4ed6479 + migration ESM fix 4994b96 on framework/md-impoc. 5 grid views + 34 indexes + pagination + dashboard matviews. Backend 669/669 green; 3 migrations applied to dev DB.

tasks.detail:
PLANNED 2026-09-10 (god). Human request: use view tables, triggers for grids and dashboard items to reduce DB calls and improve performance. Analysis: FEASIBLE.
Evidence: backend/src/modules/reports/reports.service.js loads whole tables into Node and aggregates in JS (getDashboard = Sale.findAll + reduce, SaleReversal full scan, RentalReturn full scan with 2 nested joins, inventorySnapshot = 4 queries; getTripPnlReport/getVendorSellThroughReport full-table cross-refs; getMarginsReport loads all units into memory). R-28 findings already flag: no SQL pushdown, ~25 unindexed FKs, no date indexes on sold_at/expense_date/start_date, unpaginated lists.
PHASES:
A) GRIDS (sales/rentals/expenses/units/stocks list screens) = regular SQL views (v_sales_grid per-row totalPaise/refundedPaise/units, v_rentals_grid earned/overdue/damage + counts, v_expenses_grid, v_units_grid, v_stocks_grid) + add missing date/FK indexes + LIMIT/OFFSET (or keyset) pagination. Views push join+aggregate into Postgres; the real win for grids is indexes + pagination (overlaps NOD-3 + PG unindexed-FK findings - dedupe at dispatch). List endpoints query views; keep DTO shapes identical.
B) DASHBOARD KPIs + analytics (dashboard, trip P&L, vendor sell-through, stock levels, margins) = materialized view refreshed with REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY OR trigger-maintained incremental summary tables (e.g. reporting_daily keyed by metric_date + dims) maintained by AFTER INSERT triggers on the append-only financial ledger (sales, sale_reversals, rental_returns, expenses). Dashboard endpoint then reads 1-2 indexed rows instead of 5-8 table scans.
CONSTRAINTS:
- Money stays BIGINT paise (JS already BigInt per SEC-H-7); SQL sums must be BIGINT, DTO returns String as today.
- Views/summaries are DERIVED read-only layers, never the source of truth; never mutate completed transactions.
- Reversals are subtracted, not zeroed; R-29 single-reversal partial-unique indexes prevent double-counting in trigger logic.
- Staleness vs cost tradeoff: default MATVIEW CONCURRENTLY refreshed on short interval or day-close.
NOT STARTED. Queued behind running SEC-M/L series + R-31. Manual QA: backend report/dashboard suites stay green; populated-DB latency drop (R-28 notes dev DB empty, absolute timings need seed data).

tasks.title: POS UPI QR checkout flow (Checkout button + Mark received + configurable UPI id)
tasks.details:
POS sale checkout: rename the 'Charge' button to 'Checkout' and add a two-step payment confirmation with a UPI (Unified Payments Interface) QR flow. SALE mode only (rental checkout unchanged this card).

CURRENT (frontend/src/screens/pos/POSScreen.jsx): the 'Charge' button (line ~700) calls handleCheckout which creates the sale immediately and shows the receipt. Payment method comes from the payment-methods picklist Select (paymentMethod state, default 'Cash').

NEW FLOW:
1. Rename sale-mode button 'Charge' -> 'Checkout'. Keep 'No permission' when SALES.CREATE absent.
2. Clicking Checkout opens a Payment step (a Dialog/panel) INSTEAD of creating the sale. The sale is created only on 'Mark received'. Move the current handleCheckout create-sale logic into the confirm handler; keep the SEC-M-3 checkoutKeyRef idempotency (one key per intent, reused on retry, reset after success/clear).
3. If paymentMethod === 'UPI': show a UPI QR encoding the checkout amount. Show the amount clearly. Buttons: 'Mark received' (primary) + 'Cancel'. Customer scans -> cashier taps 'Mark received' -> create the sale -> replace the QR area with a 'Thank you' confirmation, then reveal the existing SaleReceipt + 'New transaction'.
4. If paymentMethod === 'Cash' (or any non-UPI): no QR. Show the amount + 'Mark as received' + 'Cancel' -> create the sale -> 'Thank you' -> receipt.
5. 'Cancel' in the payment step returns to the cart without creating a sale (idempotency key preserved so a re-open reuses it).

UPI QR CONTENT: encode the standard deep link upi://pay with params: pa=<VPA> (required), pn=<payee, use SHOP_NAME 'SHREE Fashion Store' from components/ShopLogo.jsx or the account label>, am=<amount in rupees, 2dp from totalPaise>, cu=INR, tn=<note e.g. 'SHREE Fashion Store sale'>, tr=<txn ref>. Sale number does NOT exist yet (sale is created on Mark-received), so use the checkout idempotency key (checkoutKeyRef) as tr and in tn. Build the string in a tested pure helper (e.g. platform/upi.js buildUpiUri) and URL-encode each value.

UPI ID CONFIGURABLE FROM PICKLIST: add a new flat picklist 'UPI accounts' (mirror the payment-methods module + R-33 expense-types), but each entry needs TWO fields: label + vpa (the VPA / UPI id, e.g. shree@okhdfcbank) + is_active. So the model/migration/validation carry a vpa column and FlatPicklistManager (or a small dedicated manager) must support the extra field/column. Mount /api/picklists/upi-accounts (read=authenticate, write=PICKLISTS.CREATE/UPDATE). Seeder optional (may seed a placeholder VPA or leave empty). POS reads the active UPI account(s): if one -> use it; if several -> small selector in the payment step; if none -> disable the UPI path / show 'Add a UPI account in Picklists' hint.

QR RENDERING: no QR lib is installed. Add a pinned dependency (qrcode or qrcode.react) and verify it builds under vite 8 / react 19; render the upi:// string as a QR (canvas/svg/dataURL). Keep bundle impact reasonable.

BACKEND: only the new upi-accounts picklist module (model+migration ESM export+validation+routes+controller, register in models/index.js, mount in app.js, run on impoc_dev). NO change to sale creation and NO payment-gateway verification — 'Mark received' is a manual human confirmation.

TESTS: buildUpiUri unit test (params + encoding); PaymentDialog tests (UPI shows QR + Mark received -> thank you -> receipt; Cash shows no QR); backend upi-accounts module tests mirroring payment-methods. Frontend vitest + build + backend jest green.

BOUNDARIES/SEQUENCING: SALE mode only. Depends on R-33 (soft): both edit picklistsApi.js + PicklistManagementScreen.jsx, so sequence AFTER R-33 integrates to avoid merge conflicts. Leave changes UNCOMMITTED for god to verify+integrate. PLAN ONLY for now — do not dispatch until the human says go.

=== AMENDMENT (2026-09-10, user): add a PUBLIC customer-facing display page on a SEPARATE DEVICE (tablet/phone facing the customer). Chosen over same-browser BroadcastChannel, so it needs a public backend live channel. ===

PAIRING: POS shows a short non-guessable display code (e.g. 6 chars), persisted per terminal in localStorage so it stays stable. The customer device opens /display/:code (or enters the code on /display).

BACKEND (new ephemeral, in-memory — no DB): a POS-display channel keyed by code.
- POST /api/pos-display/:code (AUTHENTICATED, SALES.CREATE) — POS publishes the current payment state {status:'idle'|'awaiting'|'received', method:'UPI'|'Cash', amountPaise, upiUri}. Keep the payload MINIMAL: status, method, amountPaise, upiUri only. NO customer PII, NO cart lines.
- GET /api/pos-display/:code/stream (PUBLIC, NO AUTH) — Server-Sent Events stream the display subscribes to (EventSource). On connect, immediately send the current state (late-join); push every update. Heartbeat comments keep it alive; clean up subscriber on close. In-memory Map<code,{state,subscribers}> (lost on restart — fine, state is ephemeral).
- SECURITY: only SUBSCRIBE is public and it exposes just amount + upiUri + status for an active checkout (payment-facing info a customer sees anyway). Publish is auth-gated so nobody can inject a fake QR. Code is random + state resets to idle after received/timeout to limit enumeration. Note this in the PR.

FRONTEND:
- Restructure App.jsx: today ALL routes sit inside RouteGuard+AppShell. Add a top-level Routes split so /display and /display/:code render OUTSIDE RouteGuard+AppShell (full-screen, no nav chrome, no auth). The guarded app stays the catch-all.
- Display page (public): opens EventSource to /api/pos-display/:code/stream and renders states with framer-motion (already a dep): IDLE = pleasant ambient/branded animation ('waiting for next customer'); AWAITING+UPI = large UPI QR (rendered from the upiUri in the payload) + amount 'Scan to pay Rs X'; AWAITING+Cash = amount + 'Please pay at the counter' (no QR); RECEIVED = remove QR, thank-you animation, then auto-return to IDLE after a few seconds. Auto-reconnect on drop (EventSource default).
- POS side (payment step from the base task): generate/show the display code (with a link/QR to open the display device), and POST the state to /api/pos-display/:code on every transition — checkout-UPI -> awaiting+UPI+amount+upiUri; checkout-cash -> awaiting+Cash+amount; mark-received -> received; cancel/clear/new transaction -> idle. POS still builds the upiUri (VPA from the UPI-accounts picklist) so the display needs no picklist/auth access — it just renders what it is sent.

TESTS: SSE endpoint (publish updates a subscriber; late-join gets current state; publish requires auth, subscribe does not); display page renders each state from mocked EventSource messages; POS posts state on transitions.

This REPLACES the earlier 'BroadcastChannel same-browser' idea. Still PLAN ONLY — do not dispatch until the human says go.

tasks.title: Campaigns module: Instagram + WhatsApp publishing & broadcast + insights
tasks.details:
PLAN ONLY -- do not start; scope + accounts + 3 open decisions must close first. Origin: user 2026-09-11.

GOAL: a Campaigns module to (a) publish posts + stories to Instagram, (b) send offers/sales messages to WhatsApp, and (c) show insights on how each post/story/message performs.

FEASIBILITY (verified vs 2026 Meta docs + provider info):
- Instagram feed posts / carousel / Reels: FEASIBLE via Instagram Content Publishing API (3-step container: create media container from a PUBLIC media URL -> poll ready -> publish). Rate limit ~100 API posts / rolling 24h per account.
- Instagram Stories: FEASIBLE via the same Content Publishing API (stories supported since 2023).
- Instagram insights (per media: reach/impressions/likes/comments/saves/shares; stories: reach/impressions/exits/replies/taps fwd-back; account-level): FEASIBLE via Graph API Insights.
- WhatsApp offers/sales one-to-many to customers: FEASIBLE via the OFFICIAL WhatsApp Cloud API using approved MARKETING message templates to OPTED-IN customers. Billed per DELIVERED message (marketing templates have no volume discount; priced by recipient country). Aligns with our existing consent flags + delivery_logs table.
- WhatsApp message insights (sent/delivered/read + aggregates): FEASIBLE via status webhooks + WhatsApp Business analytics.
- NOT POSSIBLE OFFICIALLY (must be called out to the user): "stories/posts on WhatsApp" = WhatsApp Status has NO API. "WhatsApp broadcast CHANNELS" has NO official Meta API -- only unofficial 3rd-party providers (Whapi.Cloud, Maytapi, WAHA) that run a reverse-engineered WhatsApp client, against WhatsApp ToS, with real risk of the business number being BANNED. Recommendation: do NOT put the primary number on that. The compliant "broadcast" is Cloud API marketing templates to opted-in customers (above).

WHAT WE NEED (Meta approvals are the long pole -- days to weeks, human-driven):
Accounts/verification: Meta Business Account + Business Verification; Facebook Page + Instagram Professional account linked; Meta Developer App with Instagram + WhatsApp products; App Review for permissions (instagram_business_content_publish, instagram insights, pages_show_list, pages_read_engagement, business_management -- note old instagram_basic/instagram_content_publish deprecated Jan 2025); WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) + a DEDICATED phone number not already used in the WhatsApp app + payment method + pre-approved templates; long-lived/system-user tokens + secure secret storage + refresh handling.
Infra on our side: PUBLIC media hosting (IG fetches media from a public URL) -- S3/Cloudinary/own bucket; a PUBLIC HTTPS webhook endpoint for Meta callbacks (we have tunnels.json for dev); a scheduler/job queue for scheduled posts + insights polling.

PROPOSED ARCHITECTURE (Express/Sequelize/Postgres + React):
- Data model: Campaign (name, objective, status draft/scheduled/publishing/live/done) -> CampaignPost (one row per channel: instagram_feed | instagram_story | whatsapp_template; payload, scheduledAt, externalId, status) -> CampaignMetric (metric_type, value, fetched_at snapshots for trends); CampaignAsset (media); WhatsApp recipient list drawn from customers with whatsapp consent. Reuse delivery_logs for WhatsApp sends.
- Provider-adapter layer: one interface (publish(post), fetchInsights(post)) with InstagramAdapter (Graph API) + WhatsAppAdapter (Cloud API + webhook). Isolates Meta specifics; a future BSP swap (Twilio/360dialog) = one adapter.
- Insights ingestion: IG = scheduled poll of Graph Insights; WhatsApp = webhook for status + analytics API for aggregates; store snapshots in CampaignMetric.
- Frontend: Campaigns section (list via our DataGrid), a composer (pick channels, upload media, write caption/template, schedule), an insights dashboard (reuse reports/chart patterns).
- Compliance: WhatsApp marketing only to whatsapp-consented customers; opt-out handling; template-approval workflow.

- Phase 1: Instagram posts + stories + insights (cleanest official path).
- Phase 2: WhatsApp marketing broadcast to opted-in customers + delivery/read insights.
- Channels: decide separately; official only if/when Meta ships a Channels API, else unofficial-with-ban-risk (not recommended).

GOAL: at checkout, automatically send the receipt to the customer on the channels they are subscribed to -- EMAIL, WHATSAPP, and MOBILE NUMBER (SMS).

PER CHANNEL (feasibility + needs, verified vs 2026 provider/Meta info):
- EMAIL (lowest friction, Phase 1): HTML receipt + optional PDF attachment. Provider = SMTP (nodemailer) or transactional API (SES / SendGrid / Postmark / Resend). Needs a verified sending domain (SPF/DKIM). No regulatory gate.
- WHATSAPP (Phase 2, shares R-46 setup): receipts are UTILITY messages -> approved UTILITY template (cheaper than marketing) with a link or a PDF DOCUMENT header. Needs WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) + number + approved template + customer opt-in (we store whatsapp consent). Billed per delivered message (utility rate). Use the OFFICIAL WhatsApp Cloud API (NOT unofficial channel tools).
- SMS / mobile number (Phase 3, highest friction): 160 chars can't hold a receipt -> send a short line + a LINK to a hosted receipt page. Provider = Twilio / MSG91 / Gupshup etc. INDIA CATCH: SMS requires DLT registration (sender ID + template registered with the telecom regulator) before sending -- a real approval gate.

ARCHITECTURE:
1. ASYNC dispatch at checkout -- do NOT block the sale. After the sale commits, enqueue one delivery job per channel the customer is BOTH opted into AND has contact info for. Checkout returns instantly; a slow/down provider must never fail checkout.
2. Provider-adapter layer: EmailAdapter, WhatsAppAdapter (shared with R-46), SmsAdapter behind one send(receiptPayload, recipient) interface.
3. delivery_logs as the ledger (already exists): record each attempt + status transitions queued->sent->delivered->failed via provider webhooks; retry failures with backoff.
4. Public hosted receipt page: a tokenized /receipt/:token route (reuse R-35 public-route-split so it renders outside RouteGuard/AppShell) so SMS/WhatsApp/email can link to a real receipt. Token must be unguessable + optionally expiring; exposes only that one receipt, no PII beyond the receipt itself.
5. Idempotency: key each send to sale + channel so a checkout retry (sales already carry requestUuid) never double-sends.
6. Optional PDF renderer (server-side html->pdf) for email attachment / WhatsApp document, if we attach rather than link.

INFRA NEEDED: email provider/SMTP + verified domain; WhatsApp WABA + number + approved utility template (same account as R-46); SMS provider + India DLT registration; a JOB QUEUE (BullMQ/pg-boss) for async + retries; a PUBLIC HTTPS webhook for delivery-status callbacks (tunnels.json exists for dev); secure secret storage; optional PDF renderer.

- Phase 2: WHATSAPP receipt (utility template) -- gated on WABA setup (shared with R-46).

tasks.title: Barcode values: SHREE prefix + timestamp + counter (unique across sequence resets)
tasks.details:
PROBLEM: generated barcode values are a bare reflection of the DB sequence barcode_seq (12-digit zero-padded). If the sequence is dropped/reset (db wipe, re-migrate) the counter restarts at 1 and NEW labels collide with labels already printed and stuck on stock. User also wants every barcode to start with 'shree'.

DECISION (user, 2026-09-13): value = 'SHREE' + TS6 + CNT4 = 15 chars, uppercase A-Z0-9 only.
- TS6: seconds since 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, base-36, zero-padded to 6 (valid until ~2094; formatter throws after). One timestamp per generate call.
- CNT4: nextval(barcode_seq) mod 36^4, base-36, zero-padded to 4 (1,679,616 per second >> max batch 100 pages x 10x10 grid = 10,000).
- Uniqueness argument: collision needs same second AND same counter; within a second the sequence keeps climbing so counters differ; after a sequence reset the timestamp is strictly later than every printed label. Only a backwards system clock could break it (accepted).
- Example: SHREE0D4MWO0001.

tasks.title: Durable backups on the shop laptop: verified pg_dump twice daily (Task Scheduler) + manual encrypted upload to Google Drive via rclone + restore script; setup.ps1 registers it all
tasks.details:
USER: automatic local DB backup twice a day (times asked at setup, 24h format), a manually triggered backup that uploads the whole DB to the cloud (Google Drive, personal gmail, via rclone) into DATE-WISE folders, all registered by the initial setup script. HARD RULES: setup.ps1 has already been run on the laptop → every change must be backward compatible, idempotent, and a failing new step must never affect what is already installed and running (app, DB, .env, pm2, firewall, startup). Show the rclone encryption password ONCE at setup so the user saves it.

DESIGN:
- Backups live OUTSIDE the repo at C:\\IMPOC-backups\\{local,pre-update,cloud-staging}\\ so git/update.ps1 never see them. Shared helpers in deploy/windows/lib/backup-common.ps1 (Read-DotEnv, Find-PgTool, Invoke-VerifiedDump = pg_dump -Fc → pg_restore --list check → atomic rename, Write-BackupStatus JSON, Prune).
- backup-local.ps1/.cmd: verified dump → impoc-YYYY-MM-DD_HHmm.dump, prune >14 days, log + last-status.json; exit code non-zero on failure. Registered as two Windows scheduled tasks 'IMPOC backup 1/2' (Register-ScheduledTask, run when logged on — the laptop auto-logs in; StartWhenAvailable so a missed time runs at next boot).
- backup-cloud.ps1/.cmd (manual double-click; safe to schedule later): takes a fresh verified dump, uploads dump + backend\\.env with `rclone copy --checksum` to gdrive-crypt:YYYY/MM/DD/ (encrypted names+contents), prunes cloud copies >90 days, writes status; clear message if rclone/remote missing.
- restore-db.ps1: list local (and cloud) dumps, pick one, confirm by typing the DB name, stop pm2, pg_dump a safety copy, drop+create DB, pg_restore, migrate, restart pm2.
- setup.ps1: new final steps (each try/catch → Warn, never Fail): 10 backup folder + times prompt (24h HH:mm, validated; -BackupTimes param to skip prompt) + task registration; 11 rclone (-SkipCloud to bypass): install via winget or zip download to C:\\IMPOC\\rclone, `rclone config create gdrive drive scope drive.file` (browser sign-in), crypt remote gdrive-crypt → gdrive:IMPOC-backups with generated password+salt (rclone obscure), password shown ONCE + saved to C:\\IMPOC-backups\\CLOUD-PASSWORD-SAVE-ME.txt, connection test. Skips cleanly if already configured.
- update.ps1: pre-migration dump via the shared helper into C:\\IMPOC-backups\\pre-update.
- docs/WINDOWS_PRODUCTION_SETUP.md: Backups section (schedule, cloud, restore, token-reconnect chore). Hive docs updated.

VERIFY: PowerShell syntax check (pwsh parser) here; logic reviewed; user runs setup.cmd again on the laptop (idempotent) and reports.

BUILT 2026-09-14 (awaiting user run on the laptop): deploy/windows/lib/backup-common.ps1 (BackupRoot C:\\IMPOC-backups, env override; Read-DotEnv, Find-PgTool, Invoke-VerifiedDump = pg_dump -Fc → .partial → pg_restore --list must succeed + contain TABLE DATA → rename; Remove-OldDumps; Write-BackupStatus JSON (atomic tmp+move); Write-BackupLog monthly; Find-Rclone/Test-RcloneRemote), backup-local.ps1/.cmd (14-day retention, exit code), backup-cloud.ps1/.cmd (fresh dump → rclone copy --checksum to gdrive-crypt:YYYY/MM/DD + .env → config/backend.env, lsl confirms, delete --min-age 90d *.dump, rmdirs; token-expiry hint), restore-db.ps1 (local or -FromCloud pick, type-DB-name confirm, safety dump, pm2 stop, terminate connections, drop/create, pg_restore --exit-on-error, migrate, pm2 start; on failure prints the safety copy path). setup.ps1: params -BackupTimes 'HH:mm,HH:mm' + -SkipCloud; step 10 (folder, validated 24h prompt, two Register-ScheduledTask 'IMPOC database backup 1/2' daily, Interactive logon, StartWhenAvailable, first backup taken) and step 11 (rclone via winget or zip → C:\\IMPOC\\rclone; `config create gdrive drive scope drive.file` browser sign-in; crypt remote with New-Secret password+salt shown ONCE + CLOUD-BACKUP-PASSWORD-SAVE-ME.txt; mkdir+lsd test) — both try/catch → Warn, placed after pm2/firewall/startup; idempotent (skips existing remotes/tasks re-registered with -Force). update.ps1 pre-migration dump now uses the helper into pre-update/ (60-day prune). docs §8 rewritten.
